answer: Work history locks for 90 days. A recruit who gets slashed burns the inviter's locked history with it. Quorums must span unrelated subnetworks, so three signers from one rack do not count. The upshot is simple. One bad recruit costs the inviter 90 days of proven work, which makes bulk recruiting expensive for anyone who cannot vet. A ripple of slashes travels up the invite tree, a grove of careful inviters stays small, and the cipher of each attestation is written to the log so the next maintainer can replay it.
